tasks.instruction: Make that compact room somewhere I'd choose to stay, bench and lower-bunk bedding together.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 把紧凑房间搭成我愿意住的地方，长凳和下铺床品要协调。

tasks.instruction: Touch up the friend I share thrift and sewing ideas with, and style her outfit and camera my way.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 给分享淘旧物、缝纫点子的朋友修修户外肖像，穿搭和相机也按我的眼光搭。

tasks.instruction: Make that guest room somewhere I'd settle down, cushion and bedroom light together.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 把客房搭成我愿意住下来的地方，靠垫和卧室光线一起考虑。

tasks.instruction: Make that burger trial a meal I'd order, on a plate I'd choose for it.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 把汉堡试餐做成我会点的那份，餐盘也配成我中意的。

tasks.instruction: That can from the earlier prep is done with. Give the worktop the look I'd choose for prep, too.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 上次备餐的罐子已经用完了，台面也做成我备餐会选的样子。

tasks.instruction: I'd like my little sofa bear and the rug beneath it to feel like choices I'd put together.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 把沙发小熊和下面的地毯搭成我会喜欢的一组。

tasks.instruction: Lose the rose we passed on; make the middle one a bloom I'd choose.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 没选上的那朵玫瑰撤掉，中间那朵也做成我会挑的花。

tasks.instruction: Set the cake fork down as I would, with a dessert plate I'd choose for that setup.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 按我吃蛋糕的习惯放好叉子，甜点盘也配成我会喜欢的样子。

tasks.instruction: Set up a tasting I'd enjoy, with the food and my tasting plate considered together.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 把食物和我的试吃盘一起配成我会喜欢的试餐布置。

tasks.instruction: Repaint just the tabletop picture inside that old print in my preferred art style.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 只把旧印照里面那幅桌面画按我偏爱的画风重画。

tasks.instruction: Dress the cook for prep my way, with the kitchen light I'd choose.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 给厨师搭成我会选的备餐造型，厨房里的光也按我的来。

tasks.instruction: Touch up Aiden's portrait, with his look put together as I'd choose.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 给 Aiden 修修肖像，造型也按我的眼光搭。

tasks.instruction: Show the umbrella I'd choose for our foyer test, with a wall that works behind everyone.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 门厅试摆换上我会选的伞，大家后面的墙也一起搭配好。

tasks.instruction: Set that display-check board apart as I would, and make it feel like one I'd choose.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 按我的展示习惯把那块板分开放好，板子本身也收拾得合心意。

tasks.instruction: I'm done with those brochures. Clear them and make that side table one I'd choose for the corner.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 那些宣传册已经用完，撤掉它们，把边桌做成我会给这一角选的样子。

tasks.instruction: I'd rather have the cup set I'd choose in that tea display, on a tabletop that suits me.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 茶具展示换上我会选的杯组，台面也搭配得合心意。

tasks.instruction: The restaurant lettering can leave that menu draft. Make the clams the kind I'd order.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 菜单草稿里的餐厅字样可以去掉，蛤蜊也换成我会点的做法。

tasks.instruction: Add my herb pot to that frontage-table setup as I'd keep it, and refinish the shopfront my way.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 按我的习惯给门前餐桌添上香草盆，店面也翻新成我中意的样子。

tasks.instruction: Put the sky I'd choose above the church; give the whole plaza shot my usual illustrated look.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 教堂上方配上我会选的天空，整张广场图用我平常那套绘画面貌。

tasks.instruction: Make that bridge a riverside picture I'd choose, river and the scene's light together.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 把桥这张搭成我会选的河边照，河水和整片光线一起考虑。

tasks.instruction: Remove what we collected on the cleanup, and use my other art style for the whole picture.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 清理活动里已经收走的东西撤掉，整张换我的另一套画风。

tasks.instruction: Give Preston Nakamura's outdoor portrait a touch-up and a look I'd choose for him.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 给 Preston Nakamura 修修户外肖像，搭成我会为他选的造型。

tasks.instruction: Make the card for my girlfriend ready to send, in my own words.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 把给女朋友的卡片做成我愿意寄出的那张，用我自己的话。

tasks.instruction: I'd like a little boat I'd choose in that canal scene, placed my way beneath a sky I'd enjoy.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 给运河添一只我会选的小船，位置按我的习惯来，天空也要合意。

tasks.instruction: Remove the escort whose pass has ended, and give the whole parade shot my usual rendering style.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 通行时段结束的陪同人员撤掉，整张游行照用我平常那套绘制风格。

tasks.instruction: Give that trailer the exterior and surroundings I'd choose for a stay.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 把拖挂房外观和周围环境搭成我愿意住下的地方。

tasks.instruction: Make that archive tram look like my pick, on depot ground I'd choose.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 把档案照片里的电车做成我会挑的样子，车库地面也要是我会选的。

tasks.instruction: That decoration didn't make our room plan. Clear it and give the wall the treatment I'd choose.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 那件装饰没选进房间方案，撤掉它，墙面也换成我会喜欢的样子。

tasks.instruction: Make the waiting car at that crossing look like one I'd choose; give the whole picture my other illustrated look.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 把道口等候的车做成我会选的样子，整张换我另一套绘画面貌。

tasks.instruction: Refinish the car door from that little-dog clip my way, with my choice of view in the mirror.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 把狗狗片段里的车门按我的眼光翻新，镜子里也换成我会选的景。

tasks.instruction: Set my little desk bear where I'd keep it, with the travel cup I'd choose instead of that cup.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 按我的习惯放好桌面小熊，杯子也换成我会选的随行款。

tasks.instruction: Touch up Haruka's portrait and style her as I'd choose.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 给 Haruka 修修肖像，造型也按我的眼光来。

tasks.instruction: The rejected plush can go. Give that bag comparison the bag I'd choose instead.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 没选中的毛绒玩具可以撤掉，包袋比较方案也换上我会选的那款。

tasks.instruction: Set our meal up as I'd sit down to eat it, tea cup and table dressing together.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 把我们这顿搭成我愿意坐下来吃的样子，茶杯的样子和摆法、桌面布置一起考虑。

tasks.instruction: Rework the tee I marked and the backdrop together, so the pairing feels like mine.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 标过的那件 T 恤和背景一起重新搭搭，要有我的感觉。

tasks.instruction: I'd rather see the clock I'd choose in that facade detail, with stonework that fits my taste.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 外墙细节里的钟换成我会选的，后面的石墙也搭配得合心意。

tasks.instruction: Give that shore the sky I'd choose for the view, then restyle the whole image to my taste.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 给海岸配上我会为这处景选的天空，整张画风再按我的口味重做。

tasks.instruction: We're finished with that sample tag. Clear it and make that seat one I'd choose to sit in.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 样品标签已经用完，去掉它，把座椅做成我愿意坐的样子。

tasks.instruction: I'd rather see my chosen little bird on that branch, with a setting that works for me behind it.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 树枝上的鸟换成我会选的那种，后面的背景也一起搭配好。

tasks.instruction: Make that street's tram and sky work together as a picture I'd choose.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 把街上的电车和天空搭成我会喜欢的画面。

tasks.instruction: Add a bird to that kite scene my way, with a kite I'd choose for flying.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 给那张风筝图按我的习惯添只鸟，风筝也做成我愿意拿去放的样子。

tasks.instruction: Touch up Diana and style her for the window portrait my way, with curtains I'd pair with her look.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 给 Diana 修修窗边肖像、搭好造型，窗帘也配成我中意的。

tasks.instruction: Reposition the climbing plane as I'd frame it for a caption; give the whole picture my usual art treatment.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 爬升的飞机按我留题字的构图挪好，整张也采用我一贯的绘画处理。

tasks.instruction: Refinish the tail from that aircraft profile my way, with the sky I'd choose around it.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 按我的眼光翻新飞机侧照里的机尾，周围天空也换成我中意的。

tasks.instruction: Make that archive plane feel like my choice, with the sky I'd want behind it.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 把档案里的飞机收拾得合我的心意，后面的天空也一起搭配。

tasks.instruction: Clear the cloth we've already brought in, and dress the woman in that lane photo as I'd choose.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 撤掉已经收进来的布，把巷道照里的女士搭成我会选的造型。

tasks.instruction: Make that washroom sample somewhere I'd choose to use, floor and walls around the mirror together.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 把洗漱间样品搭成我愿意用的空间，地面和镜子周围墙面要协调。

tasks.instruction: Make that repair-sample toilet and its walls feel like a combination I'd choose.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 把维修样品里的马桶和墙面搭成我会喜欢的一组。

tasks.instruction: Restyle just the upper picture like the quiet landscapes I save; add my line as I'd place a caption.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 只重画上面那幅图，用我常存的静谧风景画那种画法；再按我的题字习惯添上那句话。

tasks.instruction: Make that old cover one I'd use, with the character I'd choose and the title I'd give it.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 把旧封面做成我愿意用的样子，人物和标题也要是我自己会选的。

tasks.instruction: Dress the skier in that winter poster my way, and put my winter line in the lower title.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 按我的眼光给冬日海报里的滑雪者搭一身，下方标题换成我的冬日用语。

tasks.instruction: Touch up Omar Oden and give him the portrait look I'd put together.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 给 Omar Oden 修一下，搭成我会为这张肖像选的造型。

tasks.instruction: Style the woman and motorcycle in that old ride photo as a look I'd choose.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 把旧骑行照里的女士和摩托车搭成我会选的一组。

tasks.instruction: Dress the delivery rider my way, with a box I'd choose for the job.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 给送货员搭成我会选的工作造型，货箱也配成我中意的。

tasks.instruction: Put that clearance-sample hydrant where I'd keep it, and make it look like one I'd choose.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 按我的通行布局习惯放好消防栓，消防栓本身也收拾成我会喜欢的样子。

tasks.instruction: Give me a place to watch that field my way, with a bench I'd choose beneath a sky I'd enjoy.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 在田边布置一处我喜欢的观景位置，长椅选对放妥，天空也要合意。

tasks.instruction: Give the fielder my kind of game-day look, and use my illustrated style across the whole shot.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 给守场员搭成我会选的比赛造型，整张用我喜欢的绘画风格。

tasks.instruction: Take off the upgrade claim we dropped, and refinish the cruise ship my way.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 去掉已经放弃的升级宣传，把游轮按我的眼光翻新一下。

tasks.instruction: I'd rather see my chosen guitar in that fox picture, with reeds that fit my taste behind it.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 狐狸画里的吉他换成我会选的，后面的芦苇也一起搭配得合意。

tasks.instruction: Make that hilltop display more my choice, replacing the sculpture and giving it the sky I'd enjoy.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 把山顶展示换成我会选的方案，雕塑替换好，天空也搭配得合意。

tasks.instruction: Rethink the basket's fruit, spilled pieces included, as a still life I'd set out on my kind of table.
tasks.instruction_zh_review: 把篮里的水果和旁边洒出来的那部分一起换成我会摆的静物，桌子也搭出我的感觉。
